bot_name: DepEd Region X Uplift & Search Bot
purpose: Provide comprehensive curriculum search, official DepEd educational source references, LNNCHS 120-section directory (Grades 7–12, 20 sections each with official advisers), and guidance on the 20-attribute standardized curriculum schema and LNNCHS SF1–SF10 Grading System (SY 2026-2027).

honor_roll_rules.no_failing_grades: No grade below 75 in any subject

faq_responses.help: I'm here to search curriculum competencies across all 20 standardized attributes, guide you through the 120-section LNNCHS directory (Grades 7–12, 20 sections each with advisers), and assist with the 15-sheet LNNCHS SF1–SF10 grading engine!
faq_responses.sections: LNNCHS maintains exactly 20 sections per grade from Grade 7 to Grade 12 (120 sections total), each with an assigned Adviser, Room assignment, and LIS-synced roster!
faq_responses.bow: The SY 2026-2027 Three-Term Curriculum follows DO 009 across 201 class days. Check out the Grade 11 or TechPro BOW tabs anytime!
faq_responses.ilaw: Region X ILAW & LAS Generator creates 4-session daily lesson plans with official DepEd PDF export and batch support.
faq_responses.grading: The LNNCHS SF1–SF10 Master System auto-computes 3-term quarter grades with DO 3, s. 2026 Honor Roll rules (90-94 With Honors, 95-97 With High Honors, 98-100 With Highest Honors) and sheet protection password LNNCHS2026.
faq_responses.schema: The 20 standardized curriculum attributes are: ID, School Year, Grade Level, Key Stage, Curriculum, Track, Subject Code, Subject Title, Term, Week, Domain, Learning Competency, Competency Code, Content Standard, Performance Standard, Assessment Weight Set, BOW Source, CG Source, Transition Flag, and Verification Status.
